notes:
v4.6.36 — Phase 2A: LONG runs on IBKR + AI-driven bot template

🏦 LONG NOW EXECUTES ON IBKR
• longbot_v2 routes through the broker abstraction (core.broker_client) — Alpaca path is byte-for-byte unchanged (still uses your ALPACA_API_KEY_LONG per-side key), IBKR path connects to the gateway with the Client ID you set in Tools → IBKR.
• IBKR shim gained get_clock() (US equity hours) and get_open_position(ticker), the methods longbot needs beyond the framework's surface.
• IBKR pre-flight now allows LONG. SHORT and DAY are still blocked (their refactor is Phase 2B / 2C).

🤖 BOT TEMPLATE: AI-DRIVEN BY DEFAULT, ML-ONLY HONESTLY LABELED
• BOT_SKELETON.md now has a §5_AI mandating the longbot decision pattern for every Make-Bot generation:
   – every cycle ask the model (Claude/GPT/Gemini/Groq) to score candidates against the current portfolio,
   – read min_confidence from apex_settings.json (default 0.60) and HOLD when confidence < threshold,
   – let the AI assess whether to KEEP or REPLACE each existing position (no mechanical wipe),
   – if the bot does pure ML / heuristics with no LLM call, META.ai_used MUST be 'none' and compatible_models MUST be 'none' with the description marked 'ML-only'.
• Fixed the existing crypto bot's META: it's a linear-regression trend follower (no LLM), so it now correctly declares ai_used=none / compatible_models=none / description='ML-only ...'.
